name: Trends and forecast
summary: How progress changes across captures: interval and cumulative charts, weekly deltas, planned-versus-actual timelines, and forecast completion and delay.

nfr.statement: Time to render trend charts for the selected locations and stage across a project's full capture history.
nfr.open_question: What p95 is acceptable, and for how many captures and locations?

nfr.statement: How soon after a capture is processed, or a correction is saved, trends must reflect it.
nfr.open_question: PRD AC-012 says "real-time". Is that a firm requirement, and what does it mean in seconds?

requirements.title: Trend intervals can be negative
requirements.statement: A trend interval is the measured quantity on one date minus the quantity on the previous date, so it can be negative. A negative interval may be a correction or physical loss, not necessarily bad data.

acceptance_criteria.given: Measured totals of 100 on 1 March and 70 on 8 March
acceptance_criteria.when: Trends are shown for that period

requirements.title: Potential delay forecast
requirements.statement: For a stage with a planned start and end, takeoff and some progress, the forecast uses the average rate per working day so far to estimate the completion date. The stage is a potential delay only if that estimate is more than 14 calendar days after the planned end. Completed work, missing inputs and zero progress or takeoff are not forecast.

acceptance_criteria.given: A stage planned to end 31 May, with progress so far implying an estimated finish of 20 June
acceptance_criteria.then: The stage is flagged as a potential delay, with an estimated completion date of 20 June

acceptance_criteria.given: The same stage with an estimated finish of 10 June
acceptance_criteria.then: It is not flagged, because 10 days is within the 14-day tolerance

requirements.title: Working days follow the project calendar
requirements.statement: Working-day counts include both ends of the range and exclude configured weekend days and holidays. Dates marked as extra working days count even if they fall on a weekend or holiday.
open_checks: Callers may not pass holidays, and this helper differs from the schedule tree's day loop; don't assume holidays are applied everywhere

acceptance_criteria.given: A Monday–Sunday range, Saturday and Sunday as weekend days, and Saturday marked as an extra working day

requirements.title: A failed trend calculation looks like no data
requirements.statement: Today, when a trend can't be calculated, or no locations are selected, the chart is empty. Users can't tell an error from an absence of data.
requirements.rationale: Recorded so product can decide how errors and missing data should look (DEC-009).

acceptance_criteria.given: The trends request fails on the server
acceptance_criteria.then: An empty chart is shown, the same as for a period with no data

requirements.title: Progress over time chart
requirements.statement: A line or area chart shows progress over time by category, stage or activity.

acceptance_criteria.then: The chart includes the new data

requirements.title: Weekly progress delta chart
requirements.statement: A bar chart shows the change in progress for each week.

acceptance_criteria.given: Progress recorded across four weeks, with one week decreasing
acceptance_criteria.when: The user views the weekly delta chart
acceptance_criteria.then: There is one bar per week, and the decreasing week is shown below zero

requirements.title: Planned versus actual timeline
requirements.statement: A Gantt-style bar chart compares planned and actual timelines.
requirements.rationale: It overlaps the Schedule capability (SCHD). Review where it belongs when SCHD is migrated.

acceptance_criteria.given: A stage with planned dates and recorded progress
acceptance_criteria.then: The planned and actual bars are shown side by side for that stage

requirements.title: Generated insights from progress data
requirements.statement: The system generates insights from progress data.
requirements.rationale: The PRD row is too vague to test. Product needs to say which insights, for whom, and from what data.
